page.layout: One printed page: running head at the top, then one column of text with the heading "CAPITIS IV. SECTIO II." and two paragraphs of italic text. Marginal notes stand in the right margin, beside the first and second paragraphs. Page number at the top right. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: Christum itaque ut Mediatorem nostrum, justitiæ divinæ pro peccatis nostris satisfecisse, & iram Dei nobis placasse, adhuc credimus.
main_text.head: CAPITIS IV. SECTIO II.

p.i: QVi ejusmodi Reconciliator noster est, ut per eum simus Deo reconciliati, seu ut per eum Deus ipse nos sibi reconciliarit eatenus, quatenus Deus ipsum constituit placamentum per fidem in sanguine ejus, ut ita per quandam compensationis viam sublata sit inimicitia inter Deum & nos, & pacem jam erga Deum consequamur per fidem in eum, quem ideo Deus fecit pro nobis peccatum, ut per sanguinem crucis ejus nos sibi reconciliaret: is certè pro nobis satisfecisse & reconciliationem nostri apud Deum impetrasse & promeruisse jure dici potest.

Atqui Jesus Christus ejusmodi est Reconciliator, ut per eum, simus & dicamur Deo reconciliati, seu ut per eum Deus ipse nos sibi reconciliarit eatenus, quatenus Deus ipsum constituit placamentum per fidem in sanguine ipsius, ut ita per quandam compensationis viam sublata sit

page.notes: The number "257" at the top right is handwritten or stamped, not printed text, so it is left out. The marginal note "mentū" and the first line of the note read as "Argumē-mentū RE-" and are uncertain. The word "simus" is printed as a long-s form and is read as "simus". The catchword "inimi-" at the foot is read as printed, with its hyphen. The page number "63" is at the top right of the header and is faint.
